summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Obelisco Manager app. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All core flows working. Fixed critical PDF export bug (jspdf-autotable v5 API change).

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

action_items: Add aria-describedby to Dialog components for accessibility compliance
critical_code_review_comments: PDF logo fetch fails due to CORS - logo image hosted on customer-assets.emergentagent.com doesn't allow cross-origin requests. PDF still generates but without logo.
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded automatically on backend startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working: Login/Logout, Dashboard KPIs, Budget CRUD with items table, Proposal generation (3 tiers), PDF export (fixed jspdf-autotable v5 API), WhatsApp send, Works CRUD with status tracking, Agenda with calendar and duplicate prevention. Backend uses JWT cookie-based auth with httpOnly cookies.

bugs_fixed.issue: PDF export failing with 'doc.autoTable is not a function'
bugs_fixed.root_cause: jspdf-autotable v5 changed API - no longer auto-attaches to jsPDF instance
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed import from 'import jsPDF from jspdf; import jspdf-autotable' to 'import { jsPDF } from jspdf; import autoTable from jspdf-autotable' and updated call from doc.autoTable({...}) to autoTable(doc, {...})
